fields.description: Platform default slot length. Branches can override on their own records.
fields.label: Default Slot Duration (Minutes)

fields.description: How far ahead a CUSTOMER may book on the portal: today + this many days, inclusive. Staff booking at the desk is never limited. Company-overridable.
fields.label: Default Advance Booking (Days)

fields.description: Base clock: a Reserved booking with no payment proof expires this many minutes after creation. Company-overridable.
fields.label: Default Reservation Expiry (Minutes)

fields.description: Verification clock: staff get this many cumulative OFFICE-HOURS hours to review a payment proof after the first upload. Company-overridable.
fields.label: Default Verification Hold (Office Hours)

fields.description: How new companies are billed by the platform unless configured otherwise: flat subscription or a percentage cut of confirmed revenue.
fields.label: Default Billing Mode

fields.description: Default monthly subscription fee for new companies (Billing Mode = Subscription).
fields.label: Default Subscription Fee

fields.description: Default commission on confirmed revenue for new companies (Billing Mode = Percentage).
fields.label: Default Commission (%)

fields.description: VAT percentage used for VAT-registered companies' billing documents (amounts are VAT-inclusive).
fields.label: Default VAT (%)

fields.description: Printed as the ISSUER on every CBT Platform Statement. Blank falls back to "Court Booking Tech".
fields.label: Platform Identity (printed on tenant statements)

fields.description: Platform-ONLY anti-abuse knobs — companies must not be able to relax these.
fields.label: Payment Proof & Abuse Caps

fields.description: Maximum payment-proof file size in MB (jpg/png/pdf only, private files).
fields.label: Proof Max Size (MB)

fields.description: Re-upload grace (minutes) after a recoverable rejection (unreadable / wrong amount / wrong reference). Granted at most once per booking.
fields.label: Rejection Re-upload Grace (Minutes)

fields.description: Maximum size in MB for a facility photo or banner. Separate from the proof cap: these are marketing photos a tenant uploads once, not evidence a customer uploads under a countdown.
fields.label: Media Max Size (MB)

fields.description: Maximum simultaneously Pending proofs per booking. Rejected proofs free their slots.
fields.label: Max Pending Proofs per Booking

fields.description: Maximum SLOTS a customer may hold unverified across ALL companies (this counts slots, not bookings, so one 4-hour booking is 4). Cap key uses a normalized email (+tag and Gmail dots stripped). It also bounds a cart: a single checkout can never be larger than this, or the customer could reserve slots they cannot then pay for.
fields.label: Max Unpaid Slots Held per Customer

fields.description: Per-CUSTOMER hourly limits on the portal write endpoints. Per-user, not per-IP: PH carrier CGNAT puts hundreds of real customers behind one address. Staff desk actions are never throttled.
fields.label: Portal Rate Limits

fields.description: Maximum portal reservations a single customer may create per hour.
fields.label: Portal Bookings per Customer per Hour

fields.description: How many bookings one cart checkout may hold. A cart is reserved in ONE transaction and held on ONE pay-by clock, so this bounds both the transaction and how many slots a customer can hold unpaid at once.
fields.label: Max Bookings per Cart

fields.description: Maximum payment proofs a single customer may upload per hour (all bookings). Staff uploads on a customer's behalf are not counted.
fields.label: Proof Uploads per Customer per Hour

fields.description: Manual email signup protection (D9). Social login is unaffected. Fail-closed: if Turnstile verification errors, manual signup is blocked — this toggle is the kill-switch.
fields.label: Registration & Anti-bot

fields.description: Enforce Cloudflare Turnstile on manual signup. OFF = wrapper passes through to the stock signup (kill-switch for Turnstile outages).
fields.label: Enable Turnstile

fields.description: Per-IP signup backstop per hour. Deliberately generous (20–30): PH carrier CGNAT puts hundreds of users behind one IP — Turnstile is the gate, this is only a backstop.
fields.label: Signup Rate Limit per IP (per Hour)

fields.description: When on, the court list never asks a visitor's browser for their location and lists every court alphabetically. Customers who saved a home pin still see the nearest courts first.
fields.label: Bypass GPS Request
